messages.author: Kankana Bhattacharjee
messages.body:
Dear AMBER users,
I have a CG protein and an equilibrated CG lipid bilayer. CG types are not
based on MARTINI or either type. How can I add the CG protein into a CG
bilayer ? Is there any tool present in AMBER ?
Your suggestions would be appreciated.
Thanks & Regards
Kankana Bhattacharjee
Ph.D. Scholar
Department of Chemistry
Ashoka University
Sonipat, Haryana

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Mon, May 27, 2024, Kankana Bhattacharjee via AMBER wrote:
>
>I have a CG protein and an equilibrated CG lipid bilayer. CG types are not
>based on MARTINI or either type. How can I add the CG protein into a CG
>bilayer ? Is there any tool present in AMBER ?
Please look at Section 3.11, "Coarse-grained and multiscale simulations
using the SIRAH force field" in the Amber 2024 Reference Manual.
...dac
